title: SubagentResponse
description: What every subagent called as a tool hands back to the main agent. UI events travel on a separate channel.

conclusion.description: The answer to the brief, in a few sentences the main agent can act on.

evidence.description: The data the conclusion rests on: ids, values, counts. Specific enough for the main agent to check.

actions_taken.description: Anything the subagent changed. Empty if it only read.

caveats.description: What it could not check, or what would change the conclusion.
